source.title: Command-Line Review Tool
source.description: Reviewing uncommitted or committed Git changes locally — install via script or Homebrew, authenticate through browser or `--api-key`, `--agent` JSON for coding agents, plus rate limits and usage credits.

source.title: Claude Code integration
source.description: Installing the `coderabbit` plugin from marketplace `coderabbitai/claude-plugin`, `/coderabbit:review` scope and `--base` flags, natural-language triggers, `-c CLAUDE.md` context, plus troubleshooting auth and slow reviews.

source.title: Plans and pricing
source.description: Free, OSS, Pro, Pro+ and Enterprise tiers priced per developer, their rolling hourly PR/IDE/CLI review and files-per-review limits, Fair Usage throttling, usage-based add-on, and MCP/linked-repo caps.

source.title: CodeRabbit glossary: review, Git, and code analysis terms
source.description: Defines `Walkthrough`, `Learnings`, `Finishing Touches`, `Profile` verbosity levels, and `Path Filters` versus `Path-based Instructions`, plus branch and status-check naming across GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Azure DevOps.

source.title: CLI Command Reference
source.description: Every subcommand and flag, from the `cr` alias and `auth`, `doctor`, `stats`, `skills` to scope flags `--committed`, `--uncommitted`, `--include-untracked`, plus `--agent` NDJSON `finding` events carrying `codegenInstructions`.
